visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women are positioned in a studio with grey wood-textured walls and a dark floor. The brunette on the left wears a mesh grey top and denim skirt, while the blonde on the right wears a striped crop top and black shorts. They start the performance with their arms raised high above their heads, facing the camera directly in a full-body shot. (2) They perform a synchronized dance routine, involving coordinated waist swaying, rhythmic arm extensions, and precise footwork stepping. The studio is brightly lit with even artificial light, and a large white clock and a logo reading "A.SPACE" are prominently visible on the wall background behind the dancers. Their facial expressions remain upbeat and focused. (3) The dance sequence concludes with both women forming hand-heart gestures near their cheeks while smiling broadly. The brunette woman then walks out of the frame towards the left, while the blonde woman approaches the camera lens directly, maintaining her positive expression and breathing noticeably from the physical exertion of the dance.
